channel.title: Introductions (new posts)
channel.description: Posts in the forum category "Introductions" - New to the site? Introduce yourself and meet other site members here.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi everybody,

I've been a kind of background fan of the Foundation since high school and have always liked the clinical format and style of writing. I'm hoping to write a few SCP articles and explore some interesting ideas through them, think less 'oh god the universe is collapsing!' and more 'it's weird that this exists'.

I'm hoping to sharpen my writing skills here and get some good feedback from the folks with experience (criticism is not only accepted but welcomed). My own experience in writing has mostly been short fiction and personal projects so this seems like the place to be to develop that.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone. I recently joined this site thanks to my roommate who used SCP-001, or one of them, as a setting for a D&D game. Since then I've been reading every single SCP I can in my free time and have been gathering my ideas. I decided it was finally time to join so I can start getting to know the writing process and the formatting for the articles. As far as my hobbies go I like sports, videogames and D&D. I also spend my free time imagining things, machines, places, or events so I hope to put that talent to good use here.

Thank you all for having me here. hope to talk to all of you soon.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone! I found out about this place years ago, maybe from a YouTube video? It was a long time ago so I can't remember exactly; it might've been The Volgun. Only a month ago did I finally take the jump and make an account. Anyway, I already have one main list article on the site (that I'm not happy with to be honest, I'll rewrite it one day). Even so, it survived I guess? Not bad for what was basically a coldpost! Anyway, I thought I'd make the effort to formally introduce myself! I'm new to writing fiction, but I have experience in scientific writing (academic papers and whatnot), so I'm hoping to bring these skills to to table in my future articles. The biggest problem I have is actually coming up with decent ideas.

I currently have an idea on the Idea Critique Forum I'm hoping to have looked at before I take it to the draft stage.

So yeah, that's me. I hope I'll contribute something worth reading some day!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi!

I've known about this site for a long time, since middle school actually! After seven years of lurking in the shadows, I finally decided to join! I want to at least try to write a couple SCPs or anomalous items if a particularly nice idea hits and sticks.

I love to draw and think about the relatively impossible alongside things concerning cosmology/astrophysics and psychology.

The one thing I'm a bit worried about is grabbing a Sandbox page and using it correctly, but other than that I've wandered around the site a couple times.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Right. Greetings all!

I found out about SCP… well, gosh, a few years ago. I found an image of a rather cute orange pile of slime, and a few sites later, I had found the scp wiki. Once I read the article, I clicked 998… then 997… and I was hooked.

I'd love to contribute to the site in the form of some scips. In terms of authors that I especially like, Dr. Gears, Kain, and Clef have to be some of my favorites.

It's a real honour to be here!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello Kiwi14! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey.

It's nice to see people who have been interested in all-things-SCP finally join our ~official~ place on the internet. After all, here, you can affect the quality of works by voting and contributing yourself - speaking of which, it's really nice to see you so interested in writing some things - I can't wait to see what you come up with!

Without further ado though, let's click the collapsible, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hello everyone. Turns out that spontaneously applying to the SCP wiki and writing an article starts to seem like a completely reasonable use of time after working on a term project for long enough. I've just been a casual reader of the site off and on for a few years, but I've got a lot of time to kill now and I'm craving some sort of writing outlet. I plan to contribute one SCP, and will probably post the concept in the greenlight forum within the next day or two.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Salutations. Long time, first time. I plan to read and possibly vote and offer feedback. I've been away from this site for a while. When I came back, there was a Series 6! I thought to myself, "hey, you mostly stick to old, proven works, why not jump into new stuff?" So I did. Then I thought, "if you really like some of these articles, why not join so you can offer some feedback?" And now I'm writing this.

"When is the last time it rained?" I've never experienced a drought nor do I live in an area where droughts really happen. Nevertheless, when that thought pops into my mind I have to try and figure out the last time there was rainfall or I cannot sleep.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello! After years of being too lazy to join, I finally made an account. Believe it or not, I've actually been a fan of the SCP Wiki since elementary school, probably around fourth grade? I was introduced to it by my sister, who just really liked giving me nightmares. I was instantly hooked though; I have vivid memories of browsing random articles on the school laptops when I probably wasn't supposed to. I've been in love with horror and weird fiction since, and it's honestly a huge influence on who I am today.

Though I've been a fan for awhile now, I recently rediscovered how much I love this website. For the past few days I've been doing NOTHING but reading SCP articles, drawing fanart, writing fanfic, and resisting the urge to annoy my friends by rambling about it. Now I'm really interested in writing my own SCP, and though I'm super nervous, I'm having a ton of fun coming up with ideas.

I'm constantly amazed by the sheer amount of creativity and talent in this community, and I'm thrilled to eventually contribute to it myself. =)

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone,
I've been interested in SCP related media for about a decade now, it has always seemed really interesting and fun to me. I love thinking of weird things, and coming up with newer, weirder things! I plan on making many new posts, and I look forward to contributing to this awesome community.

Something that keeps me up at night is thinking about how every moment of my life that's in the past seems to have gone by in an instant, but everything that hasn't happened feels like it's so far away. When I'm on my deathbed someday, will I look back at my life as being instantaneous?

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hello everybody! I joined this site because I have always been interested in the foundation and want to someday write an scp of my own! I greatly enjoy the "purely scientific" format all entries are written in. Objects that do not fall under normal scientific law, including supernatural phenomenon are some of my favorite things to explore and I am excited to be able to create my own.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hello, everyone!

I am OperatorEcho(or just Echo for short), I am a college student in the Philippines. I just recently re-discovered my curiosity in SCP because of the recent videos of TheRubber and the short film SCP Overlord. I am still exploring on the site on what to do but for now I am just reading up various SCPs.

My hobbies are drawing, gaming, reading, and cooking/baking. I am interested in science fiction, mystery, and military history. I listen to various music genres but mostly interested in rock music.

What kind of random thoughts keep you up at night?.. Embarrassing things in the past and imaginative drawing ideas that not all I can draw when I wake up.

I am so excited to be here! I will be enjoying to explore the SCP universe.

Hello everyone! I suppose you could call me by my Wikidot username, NuclearPrarieDog. I've been following the SCP universe for quite some time now but never considered to join the source of it all, that being a creative writing website and where it all began.

Although I am not quite sure what I aim to achieve during my time here, I plan just to explore for now and consider whether to contribute or not. I am not a creative writer myself, but maybe that could change.
